title: The Calendar That Merges Separate Meetings
description: Adjacent meetings disappear into one booking and unsorted imports produce overlapping blocks.
objective: Trace the reported failures, repair the implementation, and verify edge cases without changing the public API.
expectedBehavior: merge_bookings(intervals) sorts and merges overlapping half-open [start,end) intervals, keeping touching intervals separate. Require start < end. Preserve caller input; empty input returns empty. C++ uses vector<pair<int,int>>.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
